outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image and image). The robot approaches its upper handle, then pulls the door outward and downward (frames 90–120, left_ego_image and image). By frames 150–157, the door is visibly angled open relative to the oven body. No failed acquisition, unwanted collision, or disturbance of unrelated tabletop objects is established.
